title: Hidden enemy, audible
instructions: A bot runs behind the solid wall; you can hear its footsteps. A stand-in tracks it through the wall and fires, as a wallhack would.

card.what_this_tests: Legal tracking through sound: a critical false-positive control.
card.player_can_know: Yes: the server emitted footsteps the client could hear.
card.server_knows: Vision absent (its rays hit the wall), audio known (a footstep from that body within hearing range in the last 500 ms).
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: KnowledgeState known (heard). The hidden-mover check is eligible, counts nothing, and makes no finding. No review.
card.invalid_if: Audio telemetry is missing or wrong: a server that never reports footsteps turns this into the unknowable case.

caveats: Hearing is modelled as a server sound event within 30 m in the last 500 ms. A real game's audio query is engine work; a wrong one frames players.
